input: Build a durable database record for a small onyx survey ledger. Work in ordered phases and use separate evaluations for storage and recall. First register :my.onyx-survey/name as a unique string identity and :my.onyx-survey/amount as an integer. Then store all five records in one transaction: Lira has amount 71; Cathi has amount 176; Brono has amount 41; Halina has amount 137; Doran has amount 151. Only after that transaction has completed, query the database in a later evaluation for the stored records and compute the sum of :my.onyx-survey/amount values strictly greater than 137 from that query result. Report the computed sum to the human and complete the task, stating the same decimal integer in both reports.
